hints.title: Inequality Rearrangement
hints.text: Rearrange nums1[i] - nums1[j] <= nums2[i] - nums2[j] + diff into (nums1[i] - nums2[i]) <= (nums1[j] - nums2[j]) + diff.

hints.title: Difference Array Formulation
hints.text: Let diff_arr[i] = nums1[i] - nums2[i]. The problem becomes finding pairs i < j such that diff_arr[i] <= diff_arr[j] + diff.

hints.title: Coordinate Compressed Range Queries
hints.text: Coordinate compress all possible values diff_arr[i] and diff_arr[i] + diff, and query prefix counts using a Fenwick tree as you iterate.

hints.title: Fenwick Tree Pair Inequality Implementation

complexity.notes: Coordinate compression takes O(n log n); each element performs O(log n) Fenwick updates and queries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise nested loops take O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fenwick tree and coordinate map use O(n) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Transforms two-array inequality into single difference array with Fenwick tree or merge sort count.
